_comment: #015 model: same trunk + diffusion stack as #014 but with the three patches identified in the post-run analysis. Process gains logit_scale=5 (decode_to_logits sharper softmax, fixes the +1-logit soft-margin ceiling). Denoiser gains self_cond=true (Analog-Bits Self-Conditioning — input grows by n_bins=501 channels). Everything else identical to #014's model.json — same n_layers=8, d_model=384, n_mels=80, c_events=128, cosine schedule T=64, x0-param, MLPDenoiser 3-layer hidden=1536.
